description:
Toru Acura is a 20-year-old retired soldier meandering through life now that the war has ended. He encounters Chaika Trabant, a 14-year-old sorceress carrying a coffin, and follows her in hopes of finding meaning to his life again. The two travel with Toru's adopted sister, Akari, the employed member of the group and thus Toru's source of income.

(Source: Anime News Network)

name.native: チャイカ・トラバント

node.description: Chaika is usually an optimistic girl that longs to help everyone, regardless of who they are. Her speech pattern differs from the rest of the characters and speaks in the "Laake" language fluently but to avoid confusion Chaika speaks the common tongue (the official language of the continent). However, because it is not her native tongue, Chaika's language fragmented and broken. Chaika is scared easily, as seen when Akari was telling them a scary rumor. Chaika can be very clumsy sometimes too.

name.native: チャイカ・ボフダーン

node.description: Looks identical to "White Chaika", except her hair is in a shorter bowl cut, and she wears a different outfit which is red rather than white. Like White Chaika, her speech is distorted grammatically, and she also carries a giant coffin which has rollers and rope to pull along. She is essentially the opposite of White Chaika in terms of personality; stubborn, aggressive, and loud-mouthed. She carries a longsword with a snake blade as her weapon.

A dragoon of Dominica who has the ability to shape-shift. She has been living in the shadows of Dominca after her death. After losing her battle with Toru's group, she takes on the form of a Lucie Skoda in honor of her master's late sister. She also joins Toru's group on their adventures with a new goal, to have a fight to the death with Toru, although Toru usually postpoints their fight, claiming that he must first accomplish his mission to assemble Emperor Gaz's remains for Chaika.

(Source: Wikipedia)

The protagonist is a Saboteur from the village of Acura. He has dark hair and eyes, but in the anime he has dark blue hair. After the downfall of the Gaz Empire and the return of peace, he has lost his way of life. When introduced, he is jobless and poor, and initially mistaken by Chaika to be a bandit attempting to rob her. However they inadvertently encounter a man-eating Unicorn and they work together to defeat it.

He has the power of the mysterious Iron-Blood Form (also Iron-Blood Transformation) that when activated turn his hair red and cause crimson markings to appear on his body. He wields two short sword comblades that have retractable wires at their hilts.

name.native: ヴィヴィ・ホロパイネン

node.description: A member of the Gillette Corps, and an Assassin who utilizes needles as weapons. She serves as the Corp's infiltrator, alongside Zita. She greatly adores Albéric but never finds the time to properly confess her feelings to him.

She is identical to White and Red Chaika. Her main visual distinction is the makeup she wears. She is also fluent in the common language, unlike both White and Red Chaika, who speak in distorted sentences. A skilled chemist, she used her knowledge in chemistry combined with the charms of her body to charm and "persuade" men into working for her, before eventually coming upon and joining forces with Ricardo Gavarni and Grad Lancia aboard the Floating Fortress "Soara." She is an intelligent and cunning strategist, preying on the emotions of her friends and enemies alike to achieve her goals. She fights with a crossbow.

name.native: ズィータ・ブルザスコ

node.description:
A female Wizard serving in the Gillette Corps. She specializes in magic vehicles, and is the main operator of the Corps' personal vehicle "April." She has a crush on Albéric, but supports Viivi in her attempts to gain his attention.

(Source: Wikipedia)

One of the Eight Heroes and the Dragoon Cavalier. She is the Lord of Ipsom, but lives outside of the city limits, in her family's mansion in the forest. Because of this, she is rarely seen by the city's denizens, and many rumors have sprung up about her as a result.

name.native: アルベリック・ジレット

node.description:
The leader of the Gillette Corps. A cavalier from a noble family.

(Source: Wikipedia)
A wizard who, like Chaika, carries a magic rifle. She is a companion of Red Chaika alongside David, and acts as the support of their group, much like Chaika does hers.

name.native: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

node.description: A mysterious young man and Chaika's Trabant informant on the whereabouts of Arthur's remains. He appears as a hologram and helps Chaika and her companions quest.

name.native: レオナルド・ストーラ

node.description: An artificially created demihuman, bred for the purpose of scouting. Serves under the Gillette Corps as their scout and tracker.

name.native: ニコライ・アフトトル

node.description: The second-in-command of the Gillette Corps. A mercenary.

name.native: マテウス・キャラウェイ

node.description: A male wizard who can control creatures.

name.native: リカルド・ガヴァーニ

node.description: The son of Duke Gavarni. States that he enjoys dismembering people. He works along Grad Lancia and Layla.
An Acura Saboteur, and the childhood mentor of Tooru and Akari.
A companion of Red Chaika. Fights with a spear, and is often subject to physical punishment (from Selma AND Red Chaika) due to his remarks.
